name: Hopper
description: A platformer in fifty easy levels and five worlds, two of them lit by torches. Ground painted by terrain (the tile map picks its own corners), slopes, one-way bridges, ladders, moving logs, planks that give way, a mouse that finds its way to you; words in the world, eased motion, English and Portuguese, a thumb stick and jump button on phones, Ogg music, and progress saved between visits. Levels are prefabs dropped into a world's scene. Also runs in a browser.
author: Duarte Peixinho
